About Sukriti

Marketing intelligence, made practical.

I help business owners move from “we should be doing more online” to a focused plan they understand and can implement.

My perspective

Technology changes. Good marketing stays human.

AI gives businesses powerful new ways to research, create, test, and improve. But tools alone do not create trust. Strategy does.

My work sits at the intersection of AI, customer insight, and practical digital marketing. I translate complexity into a clear plan, so owners can make confident decisions without chasing every trend.

The goal is not to automate everything. It is to use AI where it creates real value—while keeping your expertise, relationships, and brand voice at the center.

What guides my work

Simple principles. Better decisions.

01 / CLARITY

Strategy should be understandable.

Every recommendation should connect clearly to your customer and business goal.

02 / RELEVANCE

AI must solve a real problem.

We use technology where it saves time, improves insight, or makes execution stronger.

03 / MOMENTUM

A useful plan is an actionable plan.

You leave with priorities and next steps—not a document that gathers dust.

The first conversation
